# Mercury Solutions

> Mercury Solutions develops software, AI and automation, computer vision and digital transformation solutions for businesses.

## Company
- [About Mercury Solutions](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/about/): Company vision, mission and markets.
- [Contact](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/contact/): Contact information and consultation request.

## Services
- [Services](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/services/): Overview of Mercury's capabilities.
- [Software development](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/services/software-development/): Software platforms and applications for businesses.
- [AI and automation](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/services/ai-automation/): AI and automation use cases.
- [Digital transformation](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/services/digital-transformation/): Digital workflows and systems.
- [Computer vision](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/services/computer-vision/): Computer vision solutions.

## Project case studies
- [Projects](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/work/): Project portfolio by industry.
- [HMB ERP](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/work/hmb-erp/): ERP for a pharmaceutical group.
- [Actiwell](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/work/actiwell/): Fitness management and member experience.
- [TNA at Fujikin](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/work/tna-fujikin/): Attendance, shifts and payroll integration.

## Practical guides
- [Vietnamese guides](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/vi/insights/): ERP scope, attendance workflows and software selection.
- [Japanese guides](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/ja/insights/): Order and inventory unification, journal CSV preparation and food lot records.

- [Japanese trial request](https://www.mercurysolutions.vn/erp-trial/): Request a manually prepared account; 30-day trial begins at activation.
